##### Project general facts

Bayview Boulevard is a waterfront residential building that combines a sleek modern design with a resort-style approach to everyday living. Drawing inspiration from nautical elements, the architecture uses a series of horizontal lines and varying depths along the façades and balconies, giving the building a dynamic and elegant profile. The residences range from one- to three-bedroom apartments, with terraces and private plunge pools that extend the living space outdoors.

The amenity offer is designed for relaxation, wellness and convenience. Residents can unwind at the infinity pool and the rooftop lounge, stay active in the gym and on the jogging track, or gather at the barbecue area. Families benefit from a kids' play area and a dedicated kids' splash pool, while a skate park and a dog park add options for active and pet-friendly lifestyles. A business centre provides a professional setting within the building.

Interiors follow a warm mid-century modern concept built around earthy tones of beige, grey, brown and tan, with travertine accents flowing throughout the spaces. Apartments are delivered semi-furnished with kitchen appliances, and curated finishes create a calm, inviting atmosphere across both the residences and the common areas.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a waterfront destination off the coast of Deira, combining residential neighbourhoods with beaches, hospitality and leisure. The area offers a relaxed coastal setting with open sea views, while remaining closely linked to the established districts of the city.

Dubai Islands Beach is within a short drive, offering a swimming and leisure destination close to home. Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport are also reachable by road, giving residents convenient access to the city's main business, retail and travel hubs.

Freehold ownership is available to international buyers. The combination of a beachfront lifestyle, convenient airport access and a wide range of hospitality and leisure offerings positions the area for both end users and investors seeking waterfront apartment living in Dubai.
